message: The aspect '{0}' cannot introduce the partial member '{1}' into the type '{2}' because the type is not partial. Add the partial modifier to the type.
rationale: In the current message, 'it' can refer to the member or to the type; the report site in IntroduceMemberAdvice.ValidateBuilder checks the target type. The message also gives no way forward, although adding the partial modifier resolves it.
